activation: Run cpg packages info zlib-ng and paths zlib-ng to select a version/prefix. The native ABI uses zlib-ng.h, zng_* APIs and libz-ng, so it coexists with system zlib.
Optionally add <prefix>/bin to PATH and <prefix>/lib/pkgconfig to PKG_CONFIG_PATH. Use explicit include/library paths; no global ldconfig or LD_PRELOAD is needed.

examples.command: cpg packages info zlib-ng --json; cpg packages paths zlib-ng; cpg packages check zlib-ng --prefix <prefix>
examples.description: Discover and check the selected copy
Create and decompress gzip using the upstream utility

notes: Two maintained definitions use the existing ID: package.json for source/binary and original material-profile.json for the complete raw tree. Select explicitly with pack --definition. Source lock and metadata.catalog are unchanged.

Native Linux x86_64 Ubuntu24.04 profile: upstream configure defaults, optimization/ISA dispatch enabled, -O2 -g0 and no -march=native added. Native and zlib-compatible ABIs are different profiles; this profile chooses upstream default native ABI. The original source preserves all compat support for developer-selected builds.

Exact prerequisites: apt.build-essential=12.10ubuntu1 for building/tests; apt.python3=3.12.3-0ubuntu2.1 for version/functional checks and independent gzip reference. No APT transaction or system-loader configuration change is performed.

Build runs official make test for static/shared examples and upstream regression cases, then builds/runs infcover directly. No gcov percentage is claimed. The larger CMake/GoogleTest/sanitizer/cross-platform matrix remains a separate qualification.

Installed checks execute native shared and static APIs against fixed checksum vectors, 15 length/level cases per linkage, malformed/truncated streams, wrong-dictionary rejection, dictionary round trip, two-chunk streaming and gzFile IO. Python gzip/zlib cross-checks actual gzip output in both directions at levels1/6/9; damaged CRC trailers must be rejected.

Relocation is limited to two actual independent prefixes on the declared target, with relative library links, RUNPATH and pkg-config. Compiler/dispatch effects are not benchmark results. Material installs verify complete inventory while executable checks remain not_run.
usage.summary: zlib-ng 2.3.3 native API with independently checked shared/static libraries, gzip file APIs and upstream minigzip; full original source/test material remains available under the same resource ID.
